customManagers.description: The .NET SDK pinned in mise (Renovate's mise manager does not update dotnet); comment lines may sit above it
The extra .NET runtime pinned in mise (Renovate's mise manager ignores the runtime element)

packageRules.description: The extra runtime is the net10.0 test runtime; the SDK carries the newest one

Ship the .NET SDK (global.json and mise.toml) and the extra runtime in the same PR as the NuGet packages: the 11.0 prerelease packages need the runtime that SDK carries, and the org preset's dotnet/runtime rule would split the runtime into its own patch PR
net10.0 assets stay on the 10.0.x release train; the net11.0 group moves along 11.0.x
The analyzer's System.Text.Json and System.Collections.Immutable ship beside it and must load in the .NET 10 SDK compiler (Roslyn 5.0) and Visual Studio: stay on 9.0.x
Only the tests and benchmarks use these: consumers of this repository's packages never get them
The analyzers build against the oldest Roslyn Keryx supports, on purpose
Prerelease pinned exactly; bumped by hand
